He does something he should never do and his life is turned upside down. Commissioner Mert Karadağ, who graduated from the Academy, starts his duty in the Organised Branch and finds his term mate Sarp Yılmaz as an enemy.

Either he will track down his brother as a mole and try to find him, or he will lose his anger and confront Celal, the Kebab maker who kidnapped his brother. On the other hand, Mert starts to get dangerously close to Füsun, who he does not know is his mother, and Eylem. The secrets of Mert inside the police and Sarp inside the mafia are gradually revealed.

Mestan starts to suspect Sarp's loyalty to Celal the kebab maker. He voices this to Celal. Mestan gets approval from Celal and starts to follow Sarp in order to find out whether this is true or not. Celal sends Mert, whom he had previously warned to stay away from Füsun and Eylem, to Füsun's restaurant to find a loophole about Sarp. Yeşim warns Sarp about Melek. He makes a plan to prevent any harm to them. He takes his team secretly from Yusuf and goes to the exchange place of Melek, Füsun and Eylem. When Yusuf finds out about Mert's move, he gets very angry that something is being done without his knowledge. Not only Celal and his men are after Sarp for Mestan's death, but the police are also after Sarp. Sarp has to clear himself without getting caught by anyone.

However, getting revenge on Köstenceli will not be easy. You need to plan cleverly and act cautiously. Mert gets in on the game. Yusuf Director plans to finish both Celal and Köstenceli at the same time.

Yusuf and his team learn that Köstenceli has been murdered, but they have not found any clues against Celal. Now both Yusuf and his team, as eyewitnesses, and Celal's men, as traitors, are after Alyanak. Coşkun, the man with the ring, reappears. He is preparing a trap for Celal through Eylem. Eylem tells Mert about the situation. While Mert is looking for Umut for Füsun, he learns that Coşkun is alive. Yusuf contacts Sarp again disguised as Necip Uyanık. Yusuf has already regretted what he did and wants to make Sarp forgive him. Mert is determined to confront Coşkun, the Man with the Ring, and ask him to account for the past. He goes after Coşkun with Eylem in the hope of finding his family. While Mert is after Coşkun, he does not realise the trap set for Eylem. Eylem gets into trouble because of the news. Sarp, who learns about Celal's new shipment, is hesitant to share this information with Yusuf Director. He is to

Yusuf Director makes one last move to prevent Sarp from giving up the police force. Celal tries to find out who are the people who reported the shipment of Köstenceli's goods to the police. A lawyer he comes across mentions someone called ‘the boss’. Sarp, Celal and his men go after the mysterious boss. Mert, who learns that he has a family, continues to track Coşkun. Coşkun starts to search Metin's hou

Celal wonders why and tells Mert that he wants to be informed about the developments. Yusuf, who has submitted his resignation petition, is about to hand over the secret police Sarp's file to Mert. Celal and his men continue to track down the boss. Füsun invites Melek to her house for dinner to thank her for what she did. Sarp's plan for Boss Hope will not be as easy as he thinks. This dangerous game will have a price.

15.o: Sarp's ‘Hope Boss’ move is defeated. The atmosphere suddenly turns to dust. It is necessary both to get Yusuf Director to the hospital and to eliminate the evidence at the crime scene somehow. Sarp feels guilty about what happened. When it is heard in the Organised Branch that Yusuf Manager has been shot, the whole team goes to the hospital. Mert wonders how Yusuf Manager came to the hospital wounded and what happened. Mert copies the security camera footage. Sarp realises that Mert has those images and tries to get them. Alyanak collapses in Sarı Hüsnü's neighbourhood. He is trying to make the people there obey him. He declares himself the man Celal could not finish.

She wants to ruin Melek's relationship with Celal and tells him about Sarp and Melek's relationship. Celal cannot believe what he hears and goes crazy, ordering Sarp to be brought to Davut's warehouse immediately.  Melek packs her bags and is about to go travelling. Mert to find out about his family, Sarp to ask about Umut and Celal to kill Coşkun. Everyone is waiting for Coşkun to get out of Organised Branch to take action. Coskun, who is aware of the danger, will act together with Yaşar to protect himself. Coşkun is increasingly cornered, he thinks that he has come to the end of the road.

19.o: Mert believes that Sarp killed Coşkun and is very angry with Sarp. He knows that he cannot reach his family without Coşkun. With all his hopes dashed, Mert decides to take revenge on Sarp. That night, when Mert sees Sarp next to Gökhan who was shot in the junkyard, his anger prevents him from seeing the truth and he tries to arrest Sarp for shooting Gökhan. Sarp tries to explain that he is innocent, but Mert, who is blinded by his anger, does not listen to Sarp. Sarp realises that he has no choice but to run away and escapes from Mert's hands. If he cannot prove that he is innocent, he will ha

20.o: Mert believes that Sarp killed Coşkun and is very angry with Sarp. He knows that he cannot reach his family without Coşkun. Mert, whose all hopes are destroyed, decides to take revenge on Sarp.

21.o: Sarp is arrested for shooting Gökhan, a secret investigator. He needs Yusuf Director's help to get out of the situation he is in. Yaşar takes the opportunity to make plans to flee abroad.

22.o: After Sarp's imprisonment, the discovery of the money that Yaşar took from the police and Sarp's immediate acquittal created some doubts in Celal's mind. He wants to be sure whether he sold himself to the police or not. A very dangerous test awaits Sarp. Celal tells Mert about his big plans for the future. What Mert does not know is that Celal will sacrifice his family and, if necessary, himself when he reaches his goal. Action tracks Mert step by step. Each new clue he finds makes him more suspicious of Mert.

23.o: Sarp and Yusuf are sure that one of the police officers who came to raid the casino is Celal's man and they have to find him. They also need to be close to Handan, with whom Celal is planning to do business.

24.o: The circle is closing for Mert. It is about to be revealed that he is Celal's informant. A great enemy from the past will upset Celal's plans.

25.o: Sarp and Celal's game is realised with Kudret's unexpected act; Tahsin is dead. Kudret comes to settle an old score. He meets Celal at the cemetery.

26.o: Kudret and Celal meet in the neighbourhood and intimidate each other. The tension between them makes the people in the neighbourhood uneasy. Celal is preparing a big move against Kudret.

27.o: Kudret kidnaps Mustafa and demands more than money for him. He proposes a trade that will lead to a confrontation with Celal. Yeşim will have to accept this offer desperately.

28.o: Celal is very angry with Kudret for what he did to her and has already sent his men to kill her and everyone else. Davut prepares a big trap for Kudret by using Fulya.

29.o: Devastated by Handan's death, Kudret assigns Serkan and his men to kill Celal. After putting Yeşim under pressure and confronting her with a vital decision, Kudret also targets Sarp and Mert.

30.o: Furious at Celal's rescue, Kudret assigns Serkan to kill Mert and Sarp. Unaware that their lives are in danger, the Yılmaz brothers are this close to the truth for the first time.

31.o: Celal is determined to make Kudret, who took his daughter Melek away from him, suffer instead of killing him immediately. However, things do not go as he wants and Yusuf Director and his team confront them.

32.o: Celal is determined to make Kudret, who took his daughter Melek away from him, suffer instead of killing him immediately. However, things do not go as he wants and Yusuf Director and his team confront them.

33.o: Mert learns that Sarp is a police officer. Both Sarp and Mert are no longer inside and they are each other's sworn enemies. Enraged by the truth, Mert wants to share it with Celal.

34.o: With Kudret as his primary target, Celal's ambition is to destroy Sarp and all his loved ones. Sarp, who learns that his mother Füsun has been kidnapped, will not be alone when he takes action.

35.o: Sarp, who is shaken by the sudden death of Yusuf Manager after Melek, experiences a great devastation. Celal, who learns that he is alive, breathes with the fire of revenge.

36.o: The Yılmaz Brothers, who parted ways years ago, are reunited thanks to Coşkun. However, they take action to settle Celal's account before making up for the years.

37.o: The Yılmaz Brothers join forces against Celal, who stole their childhood from them. The news prepared by Eylem about Celal is published on the internet, which escalates the tension.

38.o: Celal does not leave his job to chance this time and patiently lures the Yılmaz brothers into his trap step by step in order not to let them escape. Meanwhile, all eyes turn to Eylem, who does not yet know the big truth.

39.o: Celal prepares for the end by returning to the point where the story began. Umut is in his hands and the final showdown with the Yılmaz Brothers will take place. Sarp races against time as he takes action to save Umut.

Convicts Lloyd Lowery, Philomena Rotchcliffer and Shea Daniels agree to assist in the case in exchange for time off their sentences.

It turns out this violent criminal is a "collector," and has a history of kidnapping women, torturing them, and holding them captive in basements. Once the team learns he currently has a woman hidden away somewhere, the race is on to the find her before Virgil can harm her.

3.o: Theodore 'T-Bag' Bagwell, a sociopath with a prosthetic hand and a mean streak to go with it, makes a bloody escape from prison and sets out on a path of vengeance.

The team must not only catch him, but must be sure he doesn't commit any more crimes while on the loose. Their first lead sends them to the school where Joe worked as a counselor and where the six children are who he as accused of molesting. Charlie and Ray's special task force must catch her before she hurts more people -- and also make sure her 14-year-old son stays safe. Meanwhile, Lloyd's gambling debt increases and a scary Born Again inmate threatens his life if he doesn't come up with the money right away.

Meanwhile, Julianne thinks about getting romantic with one of the Kings.

One prisoner, out for revenge, brutally murders a prison guard, causing friction with the other prisoner, who only wants a big payday and to live in luxury. The murder also increases the urgency to catch the cons. Meanwhile, Ray dangles a tantalizing carrot in front of the team: between Erica, Shea, and Lloyd, whoever proves to be the most useful on this case will be the proud recipient of a tasty steak dinner.

9.o: A handsome, rich, and cunning jewel thief, Andre, escapes from prison leaving all the prison guards scratching their heads and he breaks out just in time to make the biggest score of his career. It’s up to the Breakout Kings to track him down and figure out just what he’s been plotting and stop him before its too late. Meanwhile, Shea and Erica plead with Ray to allow them to have conjugal visits.

10.o: A notorious contract killer escapes from the prison to carry out some unfinished business. As he is offing people left and right, the Breakout Kings must try to figure out the connection between his victims, catch him and lock him back up before he can kill again. The common thread between all of his victims was involvement in a tragic story involving the rape of a young female college student 5 years earlier, who’s father happens to be a guard at the prison from where he escaped.

His prey, Debbie Myers, is a beautiful, young television host. After killing an orderly, he escapes and the one thing on his mind is finding Debbie, taking her to a special place in the Adirondack Mountains and consummating their “love” through a bizarre and violent ceremony which will surely end up with Debbie being killed.

1.o: Gil Grissom is the supervisor of the graveyard shift of Las Vegas' elite crime scene investigators. Holly Gribbs, fresh out of the academy, joins the team.  Jim Brass is head of the unit and is trying to scare Gribbs from CSI.  Catherine Willows, mother of a young daughter, is the number two CSI on this shift.  Warrick Brown and Nick Stokes are competing to solve their 100th case to earn a promotion to CSI 3. Grissom investigates a murder staged to look like a suicide with precious little evidence.  Warrick and Catherine take the case of a drunk who breaks into the house where he had been stay

2.o: A man is killed after winning a fortune and then dumping his girlfriend.  So, Grissom, Nick, and newcomer to the CSI team, Sara Sidel, investigate this one.  Holly Gribbs is in the hospital and Warrick is up for suspension for leaving her at the crime scene by herself.  Holly later dies in the hospital, but Grissom doesn't suspend Warrick.

3.o: Grissom, Nick, and Sara search for a kidnapped woman and find more than they expected. Catherine and Warrick investigate the hit and run death of a little girl.

4.o: Grissom and Catherine investigate when a leg is found severed from a body in a lake.  They suspect the husband and boyfriend.  Meanwhile Sara and Nick investigate a fraternity pledging gone terribly wrong.

5.o: Grissom and Warrick take the case of a young man who is found naked in the desert without an obvious cause of death.  Sara gets to find out why the body of a woman who was buried last week is in a dumpster.  Catherine and Nick investigate the killing of a school's dean by the school's founder.

6.o: Catherine violates department protocol when she takes the case of a rape accusation against her ex-husband.  Warrick and Sara search for the missing bullet that will either exonerate or indict a cop for murder.  Grissom and Nick investigate when a female skeleton is found under a house buried in cement.

7.o: When a teenager and her sister are the sole survivors of the gruesome murder of four members of one family in a quiet suburban neighborhood, Grissom and his entire team investigate the crime. What initially looks like a bizarre cult murder becomes more disturbing when they discover the motive behind the massacre.

8.o: Royce Harmon was murdered 3 months ago in a scene staged to look like a suicide. Now another murder has taken place. Whoever the killer is he has a thorough knowledge of forensics, he purposefully has left evidence, and has baffled Grissom and his team.  Warrick and Nick investigate the case of a man who went over a cliff in his car and is now unconscious.

9.o: Grissom and his team investigate the death of a first class passenger on a flight to Las Vegas. The investigators are forced not only to examine the physical evidence, but also to interview all of the first class passengers to get their personal accounts of the incident.

10.o: Grissom and Sara investigate a bug riddled body found in the desert.  Warrick and Catherine look in to the theft of some valuable art.  Nick gets to find out why a missing woman's car is found at the bus station. Warrick is suspected of having gambled on duty.

11.o: A woman is abducted from a supermarket. In the store, Grissom finds a bathroom stall door that claims five women have been killed.  Warrick is caught in a casino on duty and is paired with a reluctant Sara. Their case is the apparent murder and robbery of a man who is found be his brother. Nick gets pulled in by his prostitute friend who gets in a scuffle with hotel security.

12.o: A man convicted of arson and the murder of his wife and child seeks assistance from Grissom to help prove his innocence. Meanwhile, Catherine and Nick investigate the underground world of sports gambling when a teenager is murdered at close range.

13.o: A bomb goes off in an office building killing one and injuring many more. The chief suspect is a security guard who left minutes before the explosion and has knowledge in bomb making.  Nick helps his prostitute friend again. After giving in to his passion, she is found dead the next morning. Naturally, Nick is a suspect and to make it worse, Ecklie has the case.

14.o: When a single human bone is discovered in the desert, Grissom and Catherine must cover miles of territory to find the rest of the skeleton. And Warrick and Sarah trace the death of a male stripper to members of a wedding party who may have celebrated a little too hard the night before the nuptials.

15.o: At a swanky fundraiser, attended by the sheriff, a woman turns up dead in the pool.  The owner of the house is away and a young couple is housesitting. Warrick looks into an apparent professional hit in the glass elevator of one of the hotels.

16.o: A woman is abducted from a mall parking garage. She's raped, beaten, shot and left for dead.  Sara collects evidence from her and grows attached to her.  Nick and Grissom analyze the crime scene.  Catherine and Warrick are given boxes of evidence from a shooting that goes to trial in four days.  The CSI who had the case has quit and they have to prove what happened.  To make Catherine's life more complicated, Eddie has taken out a second mortgage without her knowledge.

17.o: A body is found in a pottery store in what's apparently a robbery that was interrupted. Fingerprints at the scene seem to match a twenty year old kidnapping case.  Sara and Warrick look into a case where a woman burned to death in her home. The woman was burned to an ash but only the chair she was in was burned, the rest of the house is fine. Sara believes they have a case of spontaneous combustion.

18.o: A couple leaving a restaurant on their anniversary are killed in the street and their car is stolen.  The crime scene is compromised when it rains shortly after the CSIs arrive.  It gets more mysterious when the car is found and it becomes a new crime scene. Catherine looks into the collapse of a city owned residence that kills three elderly women. She runs into problems with the city engineer responsible for the building.

19.o: The entire team investigate the abduction of the infant child of a well to do family. Suspicion immediately falls on the child's parents.

20.o: Two women run over a deaf man but they didn't kill him- he was already dead.  Grissom has to find out who did it and he's not getting help from the deaf man's school.  Catherine and Nick investigate an apparent mob hit that leaves five dead in a coffee shop.

21.o: Grissom, Nick, and Warrick take the case of a jogger who was killed by a wild animal in the park. It gets complicated when they discover that the jogger had his liver removed after he was killed.  Catherine and Sara investigate the death of a six year old girl at shady carnival.

22.o: On the day Grissom has to evaluate his team, a head is found in the trunk of a car. While Gil and Catherine work on the head, Sara and Nick investigate a body in the desert that's missing it's head. Warrick looks into a murder in juvenile detention in which his young friend James is the only witness.

23.o: The team is investigating the ongoing murders by a signature killer. The killer has some knowledge of forensics and has left little evidence behind. With the investigation somewhat stalled, the sheriff invites the FBI to join the case. This makes Grissom angry and it only gets worse when Sara offers to bait the killer.

1.o: Grissom and crew are called in after high roller Tony Braun, a known drug addict, is found dead in his house by a gardener.  Since drug paraphernalia is discovered near his body and it is also determined that he had recently inhaled heroin, the cause of death is at first thought to be an overdose.  But further examination of the corpse reveals that Braun had been restrained at some point with duct tape, leading Grissom to believe that the victim was forced to ingest lethal amounts of heroin and, perhaps, other drugs.

2.o: The entire CSI team investigates a disappearance at a local university. A young woman vanished, seemingly off the face of the earth.

3.o: Grissom investigates a possible suicide at a high-profile construction site. Catherine takes on a case with a teenage boy who dies while in session with his female psychologist,

4.o: When the class clown at the local high school is found murdered, the CSI team is called to investigate, while Nick and Sara respond to the crime scene of a decomposed body found in a bag.

5.o: Grissom, Sara and Warrick are called on to investigate an abandoned, blood-splattered apartment and Nick and Catherine must examine a dead scuba diver lodged in a tree.

6.o: Grissom and his team investigate a murder suspect who is caught red-handed -- burying the victims -- while Catherine and Warrick take on the case of a woman found dead in a hotel spa.

7.o: Grissom and Nick investigate the death of a book restorer while Catherine and Sara are called to the scene of a fatal train crash.

8.o: Grissom and Catherine investigate the apparent violent death of a woman found in a sandbox.  Warrick and Sara are called to a crime scene to investigate a shooting, which initially appears to have taken place during a robbery.

9.o: Grissom and his team investigate a casino heist during which innocent victims were shot, while Catherine and Sara are called to the scene of a murder in a remote part of the desert.

10.o: Warrick heads the investigation of the murder of a con artist who turns out to be involved with Brass' daughter, and the evidence leads Sara on a counterfeit investigation.

11.o: When the body of Bob Fairmont, the real estate developer, is found, the team discovers that the crime scene has been tampered with and that the victim has been re-dressed.

12.o: Grissom and Sara are called to the crime scene when two murder victims are found hidden in pipes at a construction site in the middle of an alfalfa field, while Catherine and Nick investigate an ostensible hunting accident.

13.o: Grissom's nemesis, serial killer Paul Millander, reappears and claims a third victim in this gripping episode. The latest slaying matches Millander's previous killings in that it recreates his father's murder.  The killer's next target was born Aug. 17, 1956...which just happens to be Grissom's birthday.

14.o: Catherine is ordered by a kidnapper to accompany a man who is to deliver $1 million in ransom to him or else he will kill the man's mistress.

15.o: Grissom investigates the murder of a Las Vegas photographer whose remains were dumped at a nearby body farm where CSIs routinely study corpses, and his findings reveal that the man was apparently shot to death even though there are no bullet fragments in the body.

16.o: Grissom, Catherine and Sara are called in to investigate the death of a hockey player on the ice. Warrick and Nick look into the apparent drug-related death of a sax player at a casino.

17.o: Grissom investigates the murders of four monks who were shot point blank while chanting in a Buddhist temple; Catherine reopens a cold case in which her best friend was murdered, after the man convicted of the crime claims he's innocent shortly before he dies.

18.o: A bus carrying 23 passengers from Los Angeles to Las Vegas crashes less than 40 miles from its destination, killing nine people.  Tthe CSIs soon discover that a recent parolee was on the bus, but is now unaccounted for.

19.o: Jane Galloway lives in fear. Her doors are triple-locked. Every shade is drawn. The bathroom window is nailed shut. An alarm system is activated. Who killed Jane, and how could the murderer have possibly entered, and left, the house?

20.o: Grissom and Catherine investigate the stabbing death of an 80-year-old woman who lived in a run-down house full of cats; Nick and Sara comb through the remains of a car bombing that was, apparently, a murder plot gone awry.

21.o: Grissom and Sara investigate when a man's body, which has been doused with lye, is found buried in a park; Nick tries to determine how a hiker apparently drowned in a desert.

22.o: Grissom and his crew handle their highest profile case to date when the city's former chief of detectives is slain execution-style in his house following a wild party. Missing from the residence are the chief's trophy wife and their 7-year-old daughter.  Catherine and Warrick follow the trail to Miami, and soon enlist the help of Horatio Caine.

23.o: Season Finale. The CSIs investigate when the body of an unidentified young woman is discovered stuffed in an overturned shopping cart near a freeway underpass. Her horribly disfigured and partially decomposed face is a nightmare of blood, scabs and scars, as if she'd been shoved into a fan. A huge circular hole dominates her left cheek. Someone not only wanted her dead, Grissom reasons, but ""they wanted her ugly."" Adding to the mystery are the cart's other contents: an expensive handbag, fashion magazines and a leather day planner with notes written in code.

20.o: After the turmoil, the 3rd Sales division finally returns to normal. A new boss arrives with new methods. Meanwhile, Geu-rae’s contract nears its end.

1.o: When Shadow Moon is released from prison early after the death of his wife, he meets Mr. Wednesday and is recruited as his bodyguard. Shadow discovers that this may be more than he bargained for.

2.o: As Mr. Wednesday begins recruitment for the coming battle, Shadow Moon travels with him to Chicago and agrees to a very high stakes game of checkers with the old Slavic god, Czernobog.

3.o: Shadow questions the terms of his employment when Mr. Wednesday informs him of his plan to rob a bank (because, naturally, every army needs a source of funding). And just when Shadow thought his life couldn’t get any more complicated, he returns to his motel room to a surprising discovery.

4.o: Alternating between the past and the present, Laura’s life and death are explored—how she met Shadow, how she died, and how exactly she came to be sitting on the edge of his motel room bed.

5.o: Trying to work things out with his dead and unfaithful wife, Shadow's emotional reunion is interrupted when he and Mr. Wednesday are kidnapped by the New Gods.

6.o: On the run after the New Gods' show of force, Shadow and Mr. Wednesday seek safe haven with one of Mr. Wednesday's oldest friends, Vulcan, God of the Fire and the Forge.

7.o: Her brief reunion with Shadow over far too quickly, Laura turns to an unlikely travel companion to find her way back to life, and back to Shadow. Mad Sweeney's long, winding, and often tragic past is explored.

8.o: On the eve of war, Mr. Wednesday must recruit one more Old God: Ostara, ne Easter, Goddess of the Dawn, but winning her over will require making a good impression, and that is where Mr. Nancy comes in.

1.o: Following the epic showdown at Easter's party, Mr. Wednesday continues his quest to pitch the case for war to the Old Gods. Meanwhile, Mr. World plans revenge and Technical Boy goes on the hunt for Media.

2.o: Promising vengeance for the death of a beloved old god, Mr. Wednesday begins preparation for a great battle. Meanwhile Laura and Mad Sweeney chase Shadow’s diminishing light after his disappears. The Jinn and Salim set out to retrieve the Gungnir spear, and Shadow encounters an associate of Mr. World.

3.o: As he is tracked by Mr. World, Shadow makes his way to Cairo, thanks to a ride from Sam Black Crow. Mr. Wednesday slyly gains Laura’s help in forging an alliance with a powerful god. Mr. World introduces Technical Boy to New Media and assigns them a very important task.

4.o: While Shadow and Mr. Wednesday take a secret meeting in St. Louis, Bilquis arrives at the funeral home in Cairo, where she engages in a debate with Mr. Nancy and Mr. Ibis. Laura rejoins Mad Sweeney, and Tech Boy pays a visit to his first worshipper.

5.o: Shadow learns the ways of the dead with the help of Mr. Ibis and Mr. Nancy. In New Orleans, Mad Sweeney introduces Laura to old friends who share their world of voodoo healing. Mr. Wednesday embarks on a road trip with Salim and the Jinn.

6.o: Shadow and Mr. Wednesday seek out Dvalin to repair the Gungnir spear. But before the dwarf is able to etch the runes of war, he requires a powerful artifact in exchange. On the journey, Wednesday tells Shadow the story of Donar the Great.

7.o: In Cairo, Mr. Wednesday entrusts Shadow with the Gungnir spear. Mad Sweeney recalls his journey through the ages as he awaits his promised battle. Once again, he warns Shadow about Wednesday. Meanwhile, Laura receives sage advice from Mama-Ji.

8.o: Shadow is tormented by recent events and Wednesday has disappeared. Those that remain witness the power of New Media as she is unleashed, and the nation is enveloped in a state of panic brought on by Mr. World.

1.o: After months apart, Wednesday reappears in Shadow's life, resolved to drag him back into his war effort. A meeting with the god Wisakedjak leaves Shadow with a prophecy about his destiny.

2.o: Shadow explores his oddly welcoming new town before heading to Chicago for a gathering of the Old Gods on Koliada. Wednesday reconnects with his oldest friend.

3.o: As the search for the missing girl continues, Shadow dreams of Bilquis. Wednesday discovers the whereabouts of his old love, the Greek goddess Demeter, and resolves to free her from the grip of an unscrupulous antagonist.

4.o: Shadow and Technical Boy team up to search for Bilquis, who finds herself captive and in the midst of a crisis of identity. Wednesday visits the local chapter of notorious biker gang Lords of Valhalla.

5.o: Shadow explores notions of purpose, destiny and identity with a newly enlightened Bilquis. Elsewhere, Technical Boy struggles with an identity crisis of his own. Wednesday asks Shadow to assist in a new con.

6.o: Despite his past following him to Lakeside, Shadow makes himself at home and builds relationships within the town. Laura and Salim continue to hunt for Wednesday, who attempts one final gambit to win over Demeter.

7.o: In Lakeside, Shadow grows closer with Marguerite and uncovers the surprising truth behind a local crime spree. Wednesday makes his own shocking discovery. Laura and Salim negotiate with the enemy of their enemy.

8.o: Laura and Salim's quest forces them outside of their comfort zones as they learn to let go of their pasts. Shadow is surprised by a new side of Wednesday, while Technical Boy attempts to escape the prison of his own mind.

9.o: Shadow has to decide the price he's willing to pay for his idyllic Lakeside life. As Laura and her new ally close in on her target, Wednesday has to persuade Czernobog that it's time to make peace with their enemies.

10.o: Teetering on the edge of war and peace, the gods gather to mourn a loss. Bilquis' divine journey brings her to an unexpected revelation, while Shadow finally embraces destiny.

At sixteen, what begins as their usual summer of mischief transforms when Cadence and Gat fall in love, while adult tensions rise in her family. She doesn't know this fairy tale will end with her alone on the beach, injured and with no memory of how she got there.

But the island begins triggering memories of Summer 16, starting with a Father's Day celebration marred by rivalry, betrayal, and heartbreak.

6.o: Unable to continue keeping secrets from her, Gat finally opens up to Cadence about his perspective on the island – one that doesn't always reflect the fairy-tale nostalgia of her own experience. In the aftermath of shocking revelations, The Liars mourn their once-beloved childhood playground and unite in an attempt to save their fracturing family.

But as the truth begins to come back to her in fits and starts, Cadence realizes that she, herself, has been the biggest Liar of all.
